title: A floatable TiO2–Ag photocatalyst enables effective antibiotic degradation and pathogen growth control
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18324-18337

This study explores the powerful capabilities of a floatable photocatalyst, TiO2–Ag immobilized on expanded clay (EC), for photocatalytic antibiotic degradation and pathogen inhibition in aquaculture systems.
